// This file never imports quicktest. `qt` is an alias for an unrelated package
// and, in the second test, a local value; every Assert and Check below is a
// method on one of those and cannot reach the prohibited package-level
// functions. R1 keyed on the identifier text alone reported all four, which
// makes a repository-wide CI gate refuse correct code.
package fixture

import (
	"testing"

	qt "example.com/quantity/tolerance"
)

// asserter is a local type with the two method names the rule is about.
type asserter struct{}

func (asserter) Assert(got, want int) {}

func (asserter) Check(got, want int) {}

func TestPackageAliasedToQT(t *testing.T) {
	qt.Assert(1, 1)
	qt.Check(2, 2)

	t.Log("tolerance is not quicktest")
}

func TestLocalValueNamedQT(t *testing.T) {
	var qt asserter
	qt.Assert(3, 3)
	qt.Check(4, 4)

	t.Log("neither call can reach quicktest")
}
